English construction: It-cleft
Example: “It was the night watchman who found the open window.”
The cleft singles out the watchman as the focus.

English construction: Wh-cleft
Example: “What we need is a longer rope.”
The initial wh-clause introduces what is needed; the noun phrase after is supplies the focused value.
